title: Monotonicity of deterministic time
statement: Let $T_1,T_2 : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $T_1(n) \le T_2(n)$ for every $n$. Then $\mathrm{DTIME}(T_1) \subseteq \mathrm{DTIME}(T_2)$.
replaced:
Let $T_1, T_2 : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ be time bounds with $T_1(n) \le T_2(n)$ for
every $n$. Then $\mathrm{DTIME}(T_1) \subseteq \mathrm{DTIME}(T_2)$: every language
over the binary alphabet decided by some finite multi-tape machine within
$c \cdot T_1(n)$ steps on inputs of length $n$, for some constant $c$, is also decided
by such a machine within $c \cdot T_2(n)$ steps.
